name: Spelling practice
description: Practice this week's spelling words or climb ten levels of words. Hear each word, then type it, pick the right spelling or fill in missing letters, and apply this week's rules to new words. A grown-up adds lists and sets levels; stars are saved for each child.
author: Kinwall

addList.description: Add a spelling list for this child, like this week's words from school. If they already have a list with this title (not archived), the words are added to it instead, keeping their stars. Give words as a flat list, or grouped in categories from the sheet's headings, or both.

words.description: Words in no category, up to 60 in all

categories.description: Groups from the teacher's sheet: [{ "name": "Drop the e, then add -ing" (up to 60 characters), "words": ["giving", "hoping"], "rule": optional short rule text (up to 200 characters) }]

sentences.description: Optional sentences for "Use it in a sentence", by word: { "giving": "Thank you for giving me a hug." }

archiveList.description: Archive this child's list with this title (when the test is over). Its stars are kept.
